dialogue.line: It killed Jim because of us.
These kids keep calling you back to help them.
I don't know how, but I'm gonna find a way
to take care of them, to keep them safe.
I don't wanna be here anymore!
What did you do? Why didn't he come home?
The night we arrived here, you had a dream.
And I need you to find it.
I need you to give me some time, even if it looks bad.
Look at me. Look at me.
Lord, please protect us in this dark place.
Please stand by my daddy's bedside
and let him wake renewed in Your love.
I'll talk to Boyd about a burial.
If people find out what you did...
...that's the kind of thing that could tear this place apart.
You're gonna tell them that you lost your eye
I'm a good person and I don't deserve to be here.
What I'm doing is getting out.
What the fuck is wrong with you?
I gave... birth to one of them.
Dad, tell her that's not what you're saying.
I told all of you that there was something inside me.
Oh, it's okay. I'll get out of your way.
you don't-- you don't need to go.
I just came to get a glass of water.
Boyd said if people find out what happened--
We should probably get our story straight.
I'm not really sure I deserve to be.
Elgin, I don't want to hate you.
This place took advantage of both of us.
Neither of us will ever be the same again.
There's something I need your help with.
You wanna tell me what the hell that was yesterday?
You're gonna have to do a little better than that.
What do you want me to say?
I want you to tell me
that you're not gonna lose your shit again
and put people's lives in danger.
You got lucky yesterday. You understand that?
If Kristi had gotten hurt, you and me
are having a different conversation right now.
I don't even wanna be here.
Well, good. We're working on that.
Kristi told me yesterday that she'd seen dozens of people
with dozens of schemes about how to leave this place.
There's only thing that they have in common.
Yeah. That's probably what they thought.
Can you give me a bullet?
I'll go into the woods, and look,
don't worry, you won't even have to clean it up.
I brought you some things from your dad's car.
We're gonna take him down to the service now.
Can I have a minute to say goodbye?
We'll be right outside when you're ready, okay?
I couldn't let you go without something to remember you by.
{\an8}♪ Now I have children of my own ♪
Oh, does it fucking look like I have something?
It's in here. I know it is.
There is-- there is more to what we need to know and I just--
You don't have any acid, do you?
Henry said Miranda started seeing this place
after an acid trip they took,
you know, how the brain stores memory.
If it worked for her, it stands to reason it could work for me.
Oh, okay, um, uh, take a breath.
If you're right, and everything we need is in your brain,
then the last thing we need is for you to scramble it.
Get back to this after the funeral.
Okay. I'm not going to the funeral.
Trust me, I won't be missed.
Look, the best thing I can do for Tabitha,
is just find a way to unlock whatever's locked in here.
How are you gonna do that?
That message on the barn wall wasn't fucking around.
we have no idea what they're gonna cost.
It was the only thing I could find in the shed.
You don't have to wear it if you don't want to.
Dad said a man wears a suit to show his respect.
I'm not going to stand here...
When I was a boy, I drew pictures
so that the pictures would remember.
That's very sweet, Victor. Thank you so much.
Can I go to the Colony House with Victor?
I'll make sure that nothing happens to him, I promise.
And, uh, Bakta's just whipping you up something to eat.
Has anything like that ever happened before?
I mean, everybody sees them when they see the trees,
When did it get like this?
Well, Sara, the girl who helped me with my glasses, she--
she said that after Sheriff Boyd found the talismans
that for a long time people were safe.
It was around the night that my dad died.
We had lost a family the night before, the Pratts,
and then Jim and Tabitha, the Matthews family,
Um, not in the same car,
just they got here at the same time.
And ever since then, things have been bad?
No, no, that's not what I mean.
You mind if I borrow him for a second?
I just wanted to tell you I'm really sorry
about what happened to your dad.
Honestly, I don't-- I don't really know.
I mean, she prays a lot.
I-I didn't mean to upset you. I-- I'm sorry.
What the fuck did you mean to do, then?
No. She thinks it's our fault!
Hey, okay. Everybody, let's take a breath.
Did you tell her that all of the bad things
started happening because we came here?
no, I didn't s-- no, that's not what I meant.
that all the bad things that have happened since we got here,
do you think it's our fault?
Why did it feel like those crows were celebrating?
It's okay. Uh, we need to talk. Okay?
I mean, it seems like a lifetime ago
when we made that little space for her in our room.
You know, you haven't really talked much about what happened?
I'm trying to let go of this. I just don't know how.
I have an idea. Stay right there.
I'm gonna-- I gotta grab a few things.
Stay right there. I'll be right back.
Oh, look. Ethan, my dad is my roommate now.
This is-- This is his bed right here.
that I threw all my stuff out the window
because then it made all this space.
It's nice having a roommate now, too, be--
because you have someone to talk to,
And you can talk to me,
you know, if you're ever-- if you're ever afraid.
Have you seen any lakes here?
Uh, there's the-- there's the Brundles.
That's not very far from here.
No, I don't like it there.
Why do you wanna go see the Brundles?
Never mind. I'll find it myself.
No, but you're supposed to stay here with me. That...
I just need to see the lake.
Friends aren't supposed to keep secrets, Ethan.
If you take me to the lake, I'll tell you.
What are you doing out here?
I saw you walk off alone.
Thought you might be doing something stupid,
like going back to the ruins.
I'm not going to the ruins, okay?
I need to get something from our house.
Wait, wait. The one that collapsed?
I was inside that thing when it came down, remember?
What's in there that's so important?
I told you that thing that I can do?
He learned about it from one of his books,
and all his books are under the house now,
and I-I need to know if there's anything in there
about how to control it, so I can go back
and save my dad without getting killed.
And maybe that is stupid, okay?
But I'm not asking your permission. I'm going.
So you can help me or you can leave me alone.
There's something I need you to do for me first.
It's not what I'm looking for.
that if I brought you here, you would tell me.
I need to find the Lake of Tears.
It's a lake with magical powers.
It can make people better when they're hurt.
I thought I made it up, but my dad told me it's here.
When did he tell you that?
Maybe once I find it, it can make him better.
We need to find the Lake of Tears!
It's a kids' book though, right?
It's stories made up for little kids?
Before we got here, I thought monsters were made up, too.
This is where I talked to my dad the day the house collapsed.
He was still down there when the sun was setting.
I was so scared that we were just gonna lose him
He kept telling me everything was gonna be okay,
Hey, uh, why don't you let me do this?
I can handle a couple of books.
Besides, someone's gonna need to be up here
No, no, I should be the-- it's my thing. I should be the one--
Storywalker, why don't you let someone else
do the cool shit for a change, huh?
There's a-- There's a way in over here.
Achan caused the whole nation of Israel to suffer
And that's what you told Julie?
I just thought that maybe, somehow,
they brought some sort of ill tidings with them--
they're always one bad day away from giving up,
I-I know, it was-- it was...
we need to figure out where you're gonna live from now on.
That, uh-- that big house up on the hill, Colony House.
But there's-- there's so many people there.
Can't I just stay at the clinic?
Well, there's no extra rooms in the clinic, so...
She was really nice to me.
Because of-- of what she did?
Why-- Why would you-- why would you want to live with her?
Because I've-- Because I've seen her kindness,
and I don't-- I don't think she's a bad person.
You have no idea the kind of person she is.
I can't see you at all. Are you okay?
Just letting my eyes adjust, that's all.
How many of these books am I looking for anyway?
He kept them all in a little blue bag.
We got storage sheds around town.
The storage room in the diner,
everything we thought would be useful.
I want you to treat this place like a crime scene.
Like, these--these things, they tell a story, right?
I want you to develop a narrative.
Tell me everything there is to know
about the people this stuff belonged to.
So, why don't you do it?
You're a cop. You were trained to do this.
There-- There might be things we overlooked,
something that'll help us get out of here.
Tell me why we're really here.
You better tell me why we're really here.
Because you remind me of someone.
of someone I could've helped and I didn't.
I don't get to get that back.
But I'm gonna stand here and--
Look, I know you think everything I said is bullshit,
But if you do this for me,
think about all the people you might be helping,
the people you might be saving.
You think about the cop who first put that badge on.
You do all that, and you still want that bullet...
I think she went back to town.
Forty years, I sat in my house after my family disappeared.
I was... a lot of things.
Oh. Well, I'll walk with you.
Henry, no, it's okay. I can go by myself.
Tabitha, I don't think you should be alone right now.
So, where are you really going?
And where are you going after that?
Henry, I don't know what you're talking about.
Sure you do. You're good at a lot of things, Tabitha.
Lying is definitely not among them.
So we can play the whole charade
of me dropping you off at your house
and then waiting to see where else you go or you can just--
Okay, I'm gonna find the lighthouse, okay?
I'm gonna find my way back to the lighthouse.
I got out of here once.
If I find the lighthouse, I can maybe, maybe, hopefully,
I can do it again and take my children with me.
I'm not gonna let them die here.
How? Donna said no one knows where the lighthouse is...
No, they don't. That's why I have to do it again,
like I did the last time.
I have to go through the bottle tree.
The man in the pool, Dale, right?
He died when he tried going through.
Yeah, but... Okay, what if it was...
What if it was not meant for him?
What if it was only meant for me?
What if you end up stuck in the side of god-knows-what
I don't know. I don't know, Henry. I have to try.
You said you're going to the bottle tree, right?
I wanna see it. I want to see the tree
my wife died trying to reach.
Henry, I have to tell you something--
Why won't you tell me what's in the bag?
Ever heard of a rage room?
It's sort of a way to lash out, you know, let go
without hurting somebody or breaking shit that you need.
but I don't know how this is gonna help--
you were the one that brought me back.
You didn't even know me very well,
but you knew that I was still in there,
the dark, horrible shit that I was going through,
and you never gave up on me,
not until you finally pulled me out.
Okay, so, let me get this straight.
You made up this Lake of Tears
as part of a game that you used to play with finger puppets.
It wasn't a game. It was a story.
Okay, so, you told a story about this lake
and some finger puppets, and now-- now what?
You think the lake is here
because your dad told you that you need to find it?
Maybe I didn't make it up.
Maybe I just thought I did.
Do you remember the red rocks we found at the settlement?
My mom thought she made them up
because she used to have nightmares about them.
But the reason she saw those rocks
Maybe it's the same with the lake.
Maybe I used it in my story
because it's real, and I just didn't know.
What were you doing at the Brundles?
I'm trying to remember something that I used to know,
So, we're both looking for something
Hey, Victor, we got a lake to find.
Sophia and I have been talking
about where she wants to live from now on.
And if it's all right, she would like to live here,
Okay, that's them! Get out of there!
It's just you and me, pal.
I'm gonna, uh... I'm gonna go take a nap.
Yeah, I told Donna that I was gonna start
getting things ready for the food run tomorrow.
I did the best I could. Think it's gonna be enough?
But I think we're gonna need a little bit more.
Yeah, Victor told me this is where Miranda was going
He took me to her grave, but I...
I don't think he could bear to take me here.
This looks just like the one she made back home.
Look, I was hoping you'd realize it
on your own by the time we got here.
Henry, I told you, the tree is the one--
Yes, the tree is meant only for you.
And-- And-- And what if it isn't? What if you're wrong?
What if you end up stuck in some wall somewhere,
What happens to Julie and Ethan?
I left a note for Donna.
She'll make sure to take care of them.
Boy, well, I didn't realize you'd left a note.
I'm sure they'll be just fine.
Am I supposed to do nothing?
Finding the lighthouse could be what gets everyone home.
Then what the fuck am I supposed to do, Henry? Move!
I don't know! I wish I did know.
But if you wanna go through this tree...
you're gonna have to go through me first.
Why do you look so different?
Will that tree take me back to the lighthouse?
You told me it was the only way.
It was, but that was before.
Okay, you need to stop talking in riddles.
but I'm afraid you're running out of time.
It came from over there. Come on.
Hey. Hey, talk to me, son.
I told-- I-I told myself that it wasn't real.
I told myself it wasn't real.
It's okay. You're all right, Son.
It's all right. You're all right.
Done some things recently and said some things...
I don't know if I like who I'm becoming.
But I don't know who else to be.
if it's true, it feels like, for the first time,
Yeah, but none of it matters if...
if I can't hold these people together.
If I lose these people right now, I...
I could really use some help.
I-I-I don't know if there's anything you can do,
but if you can hear me...
No, no, no! Hey! Hey! Hey!
